entry_door: INTENT — P0 workflow change born from measured failure (48 adjudications, 0 artifact reviews overnight)
intention: The operator reviews the artifact itself after it transits each skill gate — the idea record after /idea, the intention after /intent, the ticket after /sorted — signing off on the actual text before it goes on, replacing the adjudication/findings model for these stages.
why: MEASURED 2026-08-28: 48 adjudications accumulated overnight while ~20 tickets closed autonomously. The operator never saw any of the artifacts themselves. The adjudication model is the wrong SURFACE — the operator should see the artifact, not a finding about it. The artifact IS the review surface; a finding about it is a second object the operator has to correlate back. Akien: 'I REVIEW THE ARTIFACT AFTER IT TRANSITS THE GATES. THE INTENTION. THE TICKETS. THATS WHERE I SIGN OFF ON IT NOW. THIS WILL GIVE US A BETTER VIEW INTO ANYTHING THE GATES ARE MISSING.'
traces_to: Law 9 — red is the default, green is earned; the operator's review is how green is earned for these artifacts
Law 6 — one owner per gate; the operator IS the owner, and the artifact at the gate is the surface
Law 5 — the address carries what a mind needs NOW; the artifact IS that
watchme: none, because the falsifier is checkable in one proof session — fire each skill and verify the review step presents the artifact before the next stage proceeds. See intent berth for the falsifier.
falsifier: RED if an artifact (idea record, intention, ticket) can proceed to its next stage without the operator having reviewed the actual text of it. RED if the operator's review is a separate adjudication/finding rather than reviewing the artifact itself. RED if the inbox does not surface artifacts awaiting review.
horizon: the first autonomous run after the build — did the operator get to see each artifact before the next stage proceeded?

gates.proof_gate: first real use — each skill fires and the review step presents the artifact

how: Update each skill's markdown (/idea, /intent, /sorted) to add a review step after the gate fires: present the artifact to the operator, wait for sign-off. The operator inbox surfaces artifacts awaiting review. Does not include post-build inspector or probe creation steps.
